meta.title: Magic Resume — an AI-native resume workbench
meta.description: An open-source AI resume workbench. Build a local draft, tailor your experience to a role, review AI proposals, and export your resume.

hero.subtitle: AI reads your resume and researches the role on its own. Each edit is marked in place with a reason, and you decide whether to accept or discard it

workflow.title: AI proposes. You decide
workflow.subtitle: No black-box rewrites. Every change is a proposal with a reason: red for deletions, green for additions, fully traceable, and applied only after you confirm
points: Edits are proposed in place and never applied automatically
Each proposal comes with a reason
Any proposal can be discarded. You stay in control of your resume

sync.title: Edit once. Synced everywhere
sync.subtitle: Cloud sync is on by default, so changes on any device sync in real time. Full version history lets you roll back or export at any time
points: Self-host the open-source core, or use the hosted cloud

openSource.title: Built in the open
openSource.desc: The Magic Resume core is MIT-licensed and built with its community. Read the code, open an issue, or star the repository

items.q: Do I need an account to start?
items.a: Yes. Your resumes, revision history, and job profile are stored in your account, so you can continue editing on any device after signing in. You can sign up in one step with an email address or a third-party account.

items.q: What is free, and what is paid?
items.a: The open-source editor is MIT-licensed. You can explore local editing for free. The hosted service offers Free, Pro, and Max plans; current prices, models, and included usage are shown in your account before upgrading.

items.q: Will AI change my resume without asking?
items.a: AI suggestions are shown as proposals for you to review. Accept the changes that match your experience and discard the rest. Always check the final resume before sending it.
In the cloud workspace linked to your account, so you can continue editing after signing in on another device. You can also export a JSON backup at any time.
Export a PDF for applications or a JSON file for backup and reuse. You can continue editing the resume and export another version when you need it.

items.q: Do the previews on this page use real AI?
items.a: The previews are interactive examples using sample data that show how the workbench works. Select Start creating to work on your own resume in the app.
